comment: Per-batch engagement for the welcome-card send-time experiment. Counts only — no answer text. Responses = thread replies + channel messages that mention the new hires.
baseline: typical #zengarden member post (Nov 16-22 analysis): 1-3 reactions, 2-5 replies spread over ~24h

batch_1.notes: GitHub ticks never fired (new-cron registration lag) — manual dispatch posted 22 min past target. Heritage line drove the flag reactions; the organic first response came channel-level at +6 min, so B/C must count channel welcomes too. Competing organic post 45 min later drew 8 replies. Neither new hire replied day-of.
